$comment: Completion bar for #30: only UTF-8 was read (UTF-16 SRT failed to import), a blank line inside an SRT cue dropped the rest, bad timestamps collapsed to 0, chunkCues assumed sorted input (end<start spans), and companion discovery missed .en-US.vtt/.eng.srt/upper-case extensions. Fix: decodeCaptions (UTF-16LE/BE BOM + NUL heuristic) wired into all three caption reads; parseTimestamp returns null on invalid input (invalid start skips the cue, invalid end becomes zero-duration at the valid start); parseSrt/parseVtt preserve in-cue blank lines; chunkCues sorts first; findCompanionCaptions covers regional/.eng/upper-case extensions and returns the true on-disk name. Criterion 1 fails before (decodeCaptions did not exist); 2 runs the media smoke fixtures; 3-4 guard typecheck and build. notesNear throttling (#30's last sub-item) is deferred: it needs renderer-side timeupdate changes that cannot be verified headlessly.

covers.declared: Caption decoding, timestamp validation, in-cue blank lines, cue sorting, companion discovery (+fixtures).
covers.uncovered: notesNear scan-on-every-timeupdate throttling needs renderer-side changes unverifiable headlessly.
